features.notes: Shipped. Caught a real wiring bug pre-flight: identity_key: group_id is empty for a teacher (fail-closed => would block every teacher) and a raw group code resolves to no cap => would never bite for students. Fixed with User.billing_key. Startup consistency check found gpt-5.4 / gpt-5.1-chat-latest unpriced (therefore ungated). spend_guard seam exists; its ~13 call sites are the documented follow-up.
